source: docs/INTEL_R9.md variant-candidates table (12 uncapped tokens under 100 results, each pre-mapped to an existing server)

method.registry_probe: Single bounded GET https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=<token>&limit=100 per token, curl -s -m 15, first page only, sequential, no background loops.
method.selection_rule: Confirmed each honest candidate's token count < 100 and no theluckystrike match on page 1 before publishing. Applied the honesty rule from the brief: publish only where the server's actual tools genuinely do the thing; signature/e-sign skipped outright (no server signs anything); escrow skipped unless invoice truly tracks escrow (it does not). Enforced max one new variant per server this round.
method.publish: server.<token>.json per server, name io.github.theluckystrike/<token>, version 0.9.4, stdio-only mcpb package reusing the SAME GitHub release asset URL and fileSha256 as that server's existing server.mcpb.json at v0.9.4 (no remotes[]). Login via `mcp-publisher login github -token "$(gh auth token)"`, publish via `yes y | mcp-publisher publish <file>`.
method.findable_share_formula: p = min(1, 10/our_rank) if matched on page 1, else 0. This round's 100-token set = the NAMING_R4 97-token set plus the 3 new tokens published this round. The R4 per-token p-values were not individually persisted, only the aggregate share (49.77% over 97 tokens); the pre-existing sum of p is reconstructed from that published aggregate (49.77% x 97 = ~48.28) and the 3 new tokens' p-values are added on exactly, so the 97-token portion is a reconstruction, not a re-probe, while the 3 new tokens are exact.

candidates_from_intel_r9.reason: docx's own doc_create/business_set tools literally print a business letterhead (name, email, logo, brand colour) on every proposal, contract and letter -- the word 'letterhead' appears verbatim in the tool descriptions.
barcode_create and qr_create generate scannable labels (barcodes/QR codes) for products and packages -- a literal fit, no stretch.
events_list, free_busy, conflicts and next_event operate on calendar appointments read from .ics -- genuine fit.
price-tracker only watches prices (price_check, watch_add/list/remove, price_history) -- no stock/quantity/SKU tracking tool exists. Calling it 'inventory' would be dishonest.

expense-tracker logs expenses, receipts and mileage -- no asset depreciation schedule tool. Depreciation belongs to the separate asset-register server proposed (not yet built) in INTEL_R9, not to expense-tracker.
explicit honesty rule from the brief: no server actually signs or e-signs anything.
same as signature -- no server performs e-signature; explicitly excluded by the brief.

recurring only generates invoices on schedule and forecasts revenue (schedule_upcoming, invoice_generate_due, forecast) -- it does not chase or nudge clients about outstanding items. 'followup' implies an active nudge the server does not perform.
barcode already used its one new name this round on 'label' (higher score, more literal fit); shipping would also overstate barcode as a shipping/logistics tool, which it is not.
docx already used its one new name this round on 'letterhead'; docx also has no envelope-printing template or capability distinct from its document generator.

explicit brief instruction: skip escrow unless invoice truly tracks escrow. invoice only has client_add/invoice_create/invoice_mark_paid/overdue_report -- no held-funds or milestone-release tracking. Dishonest to claim.

invoice_mark_paid records payments (full or partial) but has no refund/credit-note tool. That capability lives in the separate credit-note server proposed in INTEL_R9, not yet built. Claiming refund on invoice would be dishonest.

published_this_round.description: Print your business letterhead on Word docs, proposals and contracts from chat.
Generate barcode and QR labels offline for products, packages and assets.
Read your .ics calendar for appointments, free-busy windows and conflicts.

findable_share.note: 97-token baseline share (49.77%) carried unchanged from NAMING_R4; only the 3 new tokens were freshly probed this round. sum_p_before is a reconstruction (49.77% x 97), not a re-probe of all 97, to stay inside the 30-minute cap and the request budget.
